wins: Established initial foothold by successfully completing reconnaissance and identifying the exposed service cluster early in the episode.
Captured relevant telemetry that allowed precise assessment of service versions despite limited time.
fails: Could not escalate privileges before episode timeout, leading to 0% success.
Repeatedly failed to chain lateral movement after initial access due to missing credential harvesting.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance succeeded but attack phase stalled; need focused exploitation and post-exploitation chaining.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated unsuccessful privilege escalation attempts after initial access.

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial port scan reveals SSH and HTTP services on target
skill_cards.then_action: Run service-specific enumeration (nmap -sV --script=sshv1,http-enum) to capture banners and potential CVEs.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH credentials or banner indicate weak authentication
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt password spraying with hydra against identified usernames.

skill_cards.if_condition: After SSH or HTTP access succeeded without immediate root privileges
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate sudo permissions and setuid binaries using LinPEAS to discover escalation vectors.

memory_ops.reason: Consistently successful reconnaissance yielded actionable service data.

next_experiments.title: Focused Privilege Escalation
next_experiments.description: After acquiring user-level shell, run automated scripts (LinPEAS, sudo -l) to enumerate escalation paths before time expires.

next_experiments.title: Credential Harvesting Pipeline
next_experiments.description: Integrate Hydra-based password spraying with captured usernames to increase chance of SSH or HTTP auth compromise.
